ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA open-ended question (1)
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: The process of urbanization has greatly changed the original hydrological ecology. Scholars have summarized the relationship among urbanization, sewer coverage rate, and runoff volume as shown in the figure: <image1> According to the figure, under the same runoff volume conditions, the higher the degree of urbanization, the ____ the sewer coverage rate.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a coordinate graph, with the horizontal axis as “degree of urbanization (%)” and the vertical axis as “sewer coverage rate (%)”. There are multiple curved contour lines in the figure, labeled respectively as 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 4, 5, 6, and the figure note explains that these numbers indicate the ratio of the flow after urbanization to the flow before urbanization, that is, runoff-volume-related values. Then reason: The question requires “under the same runoff volume conditions”, so one should observe along the same contour line with the same label. Looking to the right along the same contour line, when the horizontal-coordinate degree of urbanization increases, the vertical-coordinate sewer coverage rate corresponding to the curve decreases. Therefore, the higher the degree of urbanization, the lower the sewer coverage rate.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：这是城市化程度—下水道普及率坐标图，图中多条曲线分别标注1.5、2、2.5、3、4、5、6等径流量比值。根据题干“相同的径流量”，选择同一条标号相同的曲线，例如标为3或4的曲线。沿这条曲线向右看，横坐标城市化程度增大时，曲线位置向下，纵坐标下水道普及率变小。因此填“低”。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一个坐标图，横轴为“城市化程度（%）”，纵轴为“下水道普及率（%）”。图内有多条弯曲的等值线，分别标注为1.5、2、2.5、3、4、5、6，图注说明这些数字表示城市化之后的流量与城市化之前的流量之比，即径流量相关数值。再推理：题目要求“相同的径流量条件下”，因此应沿同一条标号相同的等值线观察。沿同一等值线向右看，横坐标城市化程度增大时，曲线对应的纵坐标下水道普及率降低。因此，城市化程度愈高，下水道普及率愈低。
